card.name: The word answer after "the"
card.fires_on: The word "answer" (or "answers") right after "the", usually following a question in general web text. It points to the reply to a question just posed.

modes.label: Answer to a posed question
modes.description: "the answer" refers to a question asked just before, often followed by "to this/that".
modes.example: I did not know the<< answer>> to this, until now.

modes.label: Sentence-opening "The answer"
modes.description: "The answer" begins a sentence that replies to a question.
modes.example: So what's the solution? The<< answer>> is your common sense.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "answer" when a text has just asked a question and is about to reply.
